list.name: contratista
list.label: Contratista
list.query: SELECT id as __value, razon_social as __text FROM contratistas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY razon_social

list.name: area
list.label: Área
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM areas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

list.name: proceso
list.label: Proceso
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM procesos WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR area_id IN (${area:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

list.name: etapa
list.label: Etapa
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM etapas_proceso WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY proceso_id, orden

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.nombre AS proceso, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(e.fecha_termino, now()) - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400) AS promedio_dias FROM expedientes e JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) AND (0 IN (${etapa:csv}) OR e.etapa_actual_id IN (${etapa:csv})) AND e.fecha_termino IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.nombre ORDER BY promedio_dias DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN dias <= 1 THEN '0-1 días' WHEN dias <= 3 THEN '1-3 días' WHEN dias <= 7 THEN '3-7 días' WHEN dias <= 14 THEN '7-14 días' WHEN dias <= 30 THEN '14-30 días' ELSE '30+ días' END AS rango, COUNT(*) AS total FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(e.fecha_termino, now()) - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400 AS dias FROM expedientes e LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) AND (0 IN (${etapa:csv}) OR e.etapa_actual_id IN (${etapa:csv}))) sub GROUP BY rango ORDER BY MIN(dias)

SELECT e.numero, e.titulo, p.nombre AS proceso, am.nombre AS area, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400 AS dias_transcurridos, CASE WHEN ep.tipo_etapa = 'final' OR ep.es_final THEN 'Terminado' ELSE 'En Proceso' END AS estado FROM expedientes e JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id LEFT JOIN areas_mirror am ON p.area_id = am.id LEFT JOIN etapas_proceso ep ON e.etapa_actual_id = ep.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) AND (0 IN (${etapa:csv}) OR e.etapa_actual_id IN (${etapa:csv})) AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400 > 7 ORDER BY dias_transcurridos DESC

SELECT date_trunc('month', e.fecha_creacion) AS time, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(e.fecha_termino, now()) - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400) AS value FROM expedientes e LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${proceso:csv}) OR e.proceso_id IN (${proceso:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) AND (0 IN (${etapa:csv}) OR e.etapa_actual_id IN (${etapa:csv})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
